source_pattern: Pattern 2: Recurring gap: Acceptance test layer completeness lag
behavior_change: Executor currently marks a module build task complete without checking whether tests/acceptance.md exists for the built module; it should block final wave completion with ACCEPTANCE_NOT_COVERED when the declared task type is module-build and the target module has no acceptance file.
risk: Introducing ACCEPTANCE_NOT_COVERED into Executor's error routing requires Guard to be updated with the new error type; if Guard does not recognize it, the error will be mis-routed as HARD and halt the wave instead of looping back for acceptance test authorship. Risk is highest for legacy module builds already in flight when the change is applied.
rollback_condition: Rollback if ACCEPTANCE_NOT_COVERED blocks more than 30% of module-build task completions in the first 10 task sessions, indicating that the acceptance-file-alongside-build discipline is not yet established and the gate creates more friction than it removes.
